name: Ishiki
source: One of the characters of the Matchmaker story. Key member of the Okiai Syndicate. [spoiler]One of the people that orchestrated the events which led to the downfall of Tsuki Shinkai and allowed the syndicate to be reborn in the 25th ward.[/spoiler]
